objective: Prepare context-accurate Matthew Henry commentary and readable, meaning-first Filipino translations for Android staging-user 1.3.2, without paid APIs or regressions to Children, Bible dark mode, AdMob or navigation.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified prior staging source f340829775c904aecc9162937bc011fb16c5a34e from PR #850; EAS staging update last reported 01a1e08b-6fe8-72d1-9a5c-e6f37e6cf116. Live stage/prod manifests must be rechecked before any OTA.
chosenApproach: Preserve the verified latest staging branch; use directly declared Henry verse ranges, then conservative archaic-English idiom normalization before Google ML Kit and limited known Filipino phrase polish after translation. Keep source English unchanged, account-isolated cache v2, original attribution, and offline fallback.
selectionRationale: Sentence-grouped source-aware phrase preparation improves common Filipino readability without introducing paid AI inference or pretending machine translation is infallible; limited contextual replacements avoid unbounded paraphrase or doctrinal invention.
preserveBehaviors: Maintain all current staged 144 expanded children's lessons, bilingual dialogues, narrator, quiz and Android dark-mode readability.
Keep Matthew Henry original English and official Google translation attribution; do not fabricate verse-specific commentary.
Maintain optional Bible study and Strong's, narration, annotations, account-scoped caches and Daily Bible completion.
Preserve AdMob prefetch and fast navigation; no changes to production, assets, native modules or backend.
Meaning-first preparation applies only when target language is Filipino; English original, other languages, Google badge and offline translation behavior remain supported.
